dialogues.speaker: Esteban
dialogues.text: You won't find any courtrooms here. Criminal cases are heard in the Opera Epiclese on Erinnyes.

dialogues.speaker: Esteban
dialogues.text: Hmm... I always feel something's missing without the Oratrice Mecanique d'Analyse Cardinale and Lady Furina. But the court is hearing cases as usual.

dialogues.speaker: Esteban
dialogues.text: The atmosphere of the court won't affect the fairness of the proceedings.

dialogues.speaker: Esteban
dialogues.text: Well, I'm just a stenographer, so that's what I do — record the proceedings within the opera house.
